summary: Verification round. review-scope.mjs exited 0: 1 of 71 parts changed (2%), only dr-table. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so there is nothing to resolve. lessons:lint --strict is clean, and measure.mjs gives prose 1329 and est 19.1 against estMinutes 19. The new caption and headers read well. However, the edit dropped 「subagent、」 from the サブエージェント row. That row is the term's first use in the lesson body, so it now breaks the §2 rule that a katakana term gives its English on first use. This is a (d) must-fix, and prior drops from 4 to 3. Restoring 「（subagent、第7回）」 resolves it. The other points are niceToHave.
